clause: Text-color law (StudioColorProfile ref, no device color) [STU-TYP-014]

scope.summary: Enforce the text-color law: text fill/stroke color is NOT an ad-hoc RGB value; it references the 14.8 color pipeline and carries an explicit StudioColorProfile per [STU-DOC-003]. There is no implicit device color for type. Wire per-range fill/stroke to StudioColorProfile-tagged values / StudioSwatch references; reject untagged device triples at decode.
acceptance_criteria: text fill/stroke references StudioColorProfile/StudioSwatch; no implicit device color; untagged rejected
expected_tests: test: per-range text fill/stroke carries StudioColorProfile; untagged device triple rejected at decode
live: StudioSwatch reference on text range resolves through 14.8 pipeline

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Type carries untagged device color; color-management pipeline bypassed.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
